title: Reverse Curriculum Generation for Reinforcement Learning
notes: Grow the set of solvable starts outward from a successful region.
Judge progress on the original start distribution, not only curriculum starts.
Current probe uses measured teacher pre-hold states, not the paper Brownian state generator; no claim of reproducing the method.
Section 4 selects starts with intermediate success; Appendix A uses R_min=0.1 and R_max=0.9. Treat this as inspiration for frontier selection, not as thresholds validated for this grasp task.
